legal.privacySummary: Vector Strike collects only what it needs to run your account: your email, player name, date of birth (to keep things age-appropriate), optional country, your learning interests and your gameplay progress. Profiles are private by default. We never sell learner data, and you can delete your account at any time from Settings.
legal.termsSummary: Vector Strike is a learning platform for students. Play fair, be respectful, and keep your account details private. Rewards such as XP and coins have no cash value and can't be bought.

faq.a: Play games in the Game Zone. Every completed game earns XP based on how well you did. Your first clear of a game earns a bonus, and so does beating your personal best.
XP adds up to levels. Early levels come quickly; higher levels need more practice. Your level never goes down.
Your streak counts the days in a row you have played. Play at least one game today to keep it going. Days follow the time zone in your Settings.
Each day can have one challenge linked to a game. Meet its target (for example a minimum score) to earn bonus XP and coins once.

faq.q: Why can't I open some games?
faq.a: Some games unlock at a higher level, and some are still being built. The game page always tells you why.
Your profile is private by default. Players under 13 always have private profiles. Your email and age are never shown to other players.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Go to Settings, then Account actions, then Delete account. This permanently removes your progress.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.subtitle: Vector Strike is built to be playable by as many learners as possible.
points: Every screen works with a keyboard, and focus is always visible.
Screen readers get labels for icons, progress bars and charts (charts include a data table).
You can reduce motion, enlarge text and turn on high contrast in Settings.
Status is never shown by colour alone: icons and text always accompany it.
Touch targets are at least 44 pixels on phones and tablets.
